Madhya Pradesh Prepares for 48,000 Teacher Recruitment

Madhya Pradesh is preparing to recruit for 48,000 positions. As part of this process, 30,000 teachers will receive promotions after passing an eligibility test. The syllabus for the teacher eligibility test has been released, with the Department of Public Instruction (DPI) clarifying the format. The exam will consist of 150 multiple-choice questions.
